description: First empirical execution of Proposition 4's sandwich. E2 populates the base-model row of a 2x2 (model state x membership), yielding tau_mod as an upper bound on tau_rec and, from the same square, a direct test of A3 (Delta_A3 = EMR(C) - EMR_base(C)) plus a known-answer sanity cell (tau_base = 0 by construction). Adds the covariate-balance table required by Algorithm 1 step 2 at zero GPU cost. E5 (frequency dose-response) was designed and dropped -- see design.md.
